{{Top|leg}}
'''Toria Tell's Droid Journal''' was a small, private [[Scandoc/Legends|scandoc]] maintained by [[Toria Tell]], distributed in a limited fashion around the galaxy. One release of this scandoc during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] included information on the [[TelBrinTel Corporation|TelBrinTel]] [[Science Research Droid]], the [[Lovolan]] [[Supreme-Class Servant Droid|''Supreme''-class servant droid]], the [[Scavenger Series Labor and Recycling Droid]], the [[Ulban Arms/Legends|Ulban Arms]] [[Class I Defense Droid]], and the [[Publictechnic]] [[850.AA Public Service Headquarters]] and Maintenance Droid.<ref name="SWAJ10">{{JournalCite|10|Toria Tell's Droid Journal (article)}}</ref>
